---
title: "The seven quality principles"
description: "The seven principles the playbook is built on."
---

NHSBSA analysis informs how public money is spent, how services are run, and what the public is
told. Seven principles apply to all of it.

## The principles

<details class="nhsuk-details nhsuk-expander">
<summary class="nhsuk-details__summary"><span class="nhsuk-details__summary-text">1. Analysis answers the right questions</span></summary>
<div class="nhsuk-details__text">

There should be a clear, shared understanding of the questions to be answered, how they meet user
needs, and **how certain the answer needs to be**. Analysis should be for the public good and aligned
to government policy and organisational objectives.

</div>
</details>

<details class="nhsuk-details nhsuk-expander">
<summary class="nhsuk-details__summary"><span class="nhsuk-details__summary-text">2. Using the right methods</span></summary>
<div class="nhsuk-details__text">

Analysis uses appropriate inputs and methods to produce high quality results. It should be
repeatable, independent, grounded in reality, objective, with
[uncertainty](../09-resources/r10-uncertainty.qmd) understood and managed, and it should answer the original
question robustly.

</div>
</details>

<details class="nhsuk-details nhsuk-expander">
<summary class="nhsuk-details__summary"><span class="nhsuk-details__summary-text">3. At the right time</span></summary>
<div class="nhsuk-details__text">

Analysis is provided in time to be useful. **That is never at the expense of quality assurance.**

</div>
</details>

<details class="nhsuk-details nhsuk-expander">
<summary class="nhsuk-details__summary"><span class="nhsuk-details__summary-text">4. With the right level of quality assurance</span></summary>
<div class="nhsuk-details__text">

Quality assurance **and continuous improvement** are built into the way analysis is carried out.
Assurance is proportionate to the impact of the results on the decision, and to the risks of how
they will be used.

</div>
</details>

<details class="nhsuk-details nhsuk-expander">
<summary class="nhsuk-details__summary"><span class="nhsuk-details__summary-text">5. Following the right standards</span></summary>
<div class="nhsuk-details__text">

Analysis is undertaken in line with legal and ethical obligations, with public service codes of
conduct, and with those of your own profession.

</div>
</details>

<details class="nhsuk-details nhsuk-expander">
<summary class="nhsuk-details__summary"><span class="nhsuk-details__summary-text">6. Presented in the right way</span></summary>
<div class="nhsuk-details__text">

Analysis supports effective decision-making and meets user needs through clearly presented,
impartial, timely and accessible outputs. That includes being clear about context, strengths,
limitations, and **what remains uncertain, stated plainly enough to act on**.

</div>
</details>

<details class="nhsuk-details nhsuk-expander">
<summary class="nhsuk-details__summary"><span class="nhsuk-details__summary-text">7. So the right decisions are made</span></summary>
<div class="nhsuk-details__text">

Good quality analysis can be trusted to support effective decision-making and meet user needs.

</div>
</details>
